what: Every bet in Gamdom's public Crash bet feed for one window on 8 and 9 October 2026, as broadcast to every visitor of the Crash page (player_bet and cashed_out events)

fields.game_id: the round the bet was placed in (all in data/rounds-2026-10-08.csv)
fields.player: rank of the player's stake total in this window (p1 = largest); names and Gamdom user ids removed; 'test' = the PF.org test account (data/our-bets-2026-10-08.csv)
fields.stake_coins: the stake in Gamdom's coin unit, 1 coin = $1/1500 (data/units-2026-10-08.json)
fields.cashout: the multiplier the bet cashed out at; blank if the bet lost (the feed never shows a losing bet's target)

windowNote: window start is the first round announced in the feed, window end the last round's crash
